Essential Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Planning/Architecture/Civil/Municipal Engineering OR Master's Degree in Geography/Sociology/Economics from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent.
Post-graduation in Planning with specialization in Town/City/Urban/Housing/Transport/Environmental Planning from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent.
At least 05 years' experience in a planning office in a development authority, local body, or Government Undertaking.

Associate Membership of the Institute of Town Planners (India).

Degree in Architecture from a recognized University/Institution or equivalent.
Membership of the Council of Architecture.
Desirable Qualifications:- Associate Membership of Institute or equivalent. &  2 Years' experience in a responsible capacity.
Post-Graduation Diploma in Landscape Architecture.
Degree in Architecture from a recognized University/Institution or equivalent. OR Bachelor's Degree in Botany or Agriculture or Horticulture from a recognized University/Institution.
At least one-year experience in Landscape Planning in a responsible capacity.
Essential Qualification (Any one of the following):-
M.E. / M. Tech. in Computer Science / IT with First Class or a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate from a Govt. recognized Institution / University. OR

B.E. / B. Tech. / M.Sc. in Computer Science / IT / MCA with First Class or a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate from a Govt. recognized Institution / University AND with one-year experience in the relevant field.
Essential Qualification (Any one of the following):-

Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Educational Institution in India (incorporated by an Act of Central/State Legislature, established by an Act of Parliament, or 'Deemed University' under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956). OR
Passed Sections A and B of the Institution Examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India) in Civil Engineering. OR
Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a foreign University/College/Institution recognized by the Government under specified conditions.
Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized University/ Institution.
Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent degree.
Specialization must be in one of the following fields: Personnel, HR, Industrial Relation, Real Estate/Urban Management, Finance, or Marketing.
Note on Specialization:-  Specialization is only considered valid if the candidate has passed a minimum of 6 papers/courses in the mentioned specialization/field.
1. Educational Requirement (Any one of the following):
Engineering Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Electronics from a recognized University/College/Institute. OR
Master Degree in Computer Science/Computer Application from a recognized University/College/Institute. OR
'B' Level examination passed from the Deptt. Of Electronics Accreditations of Computer Course (DOEACC).
2. Experience Requirement:- One year experience in Software Development, RDBMS and Data Processing.
Bachelor Degree in Planning/ Architecture from a recognized University  /Institute or equivalent.
Degree in Architecture from a recognized University/ Institution or equivalent.
1. Educational Requirement (Any one of the following):-
Engineering Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Electronics from a recognized University/College/Institute. OR
Master Degree in Computer Science/Computer Application from a recognized University/College/Institute. OR
'B' Level examination passed from the Deptt. Of Electronics Accreditations of Computer Course (DOEACC).
2. Experience Requirement:- One year experience in Software Development, RDBMS and Data Processing.

Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institution or equivalent.

																Note: B.Tech (Electrical or Mechanical Engineering) Degree Holder may also apply.
Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture or Horticulture or Forestry from a recognized University or Institute or equivalent.
Degree from a recognized University or equivalent with 50% marks or above.
Desirable Qualifications:-
Knowledge of application of various acts, regulation and procedures concerning Land and Estate matters.
Possession of Degree in Law (an added advantage).
1. Educational Qualification (Must meet one of the following):-
Master's Degree in Hindi with English as a subject at the Degree level. OR
Master's Degree in English with Hindi as a subject at the Degree level.
AND
2. Translation Requirement (Must meet one of the following):-
Recognized Diploma/Certificate Course in translation (Hindi to English and vice-versa).
OR
Two years' experience in Hindi to English and vice-versa translation work in Central/State Government offices/PSUs/Autonomous bodies.
Bachelor's degree from a recognized University or institute.
Three years' experience in security and fire fighting duties in an organization recognized by the Central or State Government, OR regular service in defense or police.
Physical Requirements (Male):
Height: 170 cm (Relaxable by 5 cm for Gorkhas/Garhwalis).
Chest (Normal/Expanded): 81 cm / 85 cm (Relaxable by 5 cm for hill areas/ST).
Weight: 55 kg.
Height (Female): 157 cm (Relaxable by 2 cm for Gorkhas/Garhwalis).

Diploma or two years’ National Trade Certificate in Surveying from a recognized Institute or equivalent
																and
Two years’ experience in Survey work
Senior Secondary Certificate (12th Class Pass ) or equivalent from recognized Board /University.
Typing speed of 40 w.p.m. in English or 35 w.p.m. in Hindi on Computer.
Skill Test Norms: Dictation- 10 min. at the speed of 80 w.p.m. & Transcription-(only on computer) 50 minutes (English) & 65 minutes (Hindi)

Graduate from any recognized University or equivalent thereof.

																i) Proficiency in computer.
																ii) Working knowledge of Urdu/Hindi
